acceptance_evidence.evidence: control.rs bumps only CONTROL_PROTOCOL_VERSION to 2 and adds direct coop-protocol presence records with internally tagged, deny_unknown_fields JSONL variants; bounded event serialization retains the 512-byte line limit and no generic payload variant exists.

server.rs validates current epoch and acknowledged ROM readiness, checks RFC-1982 outer-sequence freshness, decodes exact LocalPresenceStateV1 (28 bytes) or PresenceInteractionV1 (20 bytes), then commits before one bounded event write; malformed frames return fixed protocol violations without sequence commit.

handle_presence_command encodes RemotePlayerSpawn/Update/Despawn directly into their exact 72/40/16-byte payloads, preserves embedded cloud sequences, allocates sidecar sequence_state independently, stamps the authenticated epoch, and writes only via BridgeWriter.

Presence commands use a dedicated bounded capacity-one receiver and fast path before command ledger/deferred handling; restored routine backpressure guards remain in place, while readiness/quiescing checks reject without allocation or bridge write.

ROM reboot rearm retains outgoing sidecar sequence, resets incoming session cursor to sequence 1, writes SESSION_READY before RomPresenceReset, discards stale presence, and retains a pending reset mark for control reconnect delivery; sidecar tests pass with the reset event ordering.

Final coop-sidecar package verification passed 80 tests; strict Clippy passed with -D warnings; cargo fmt --check and git diff --check passed. Final diff status contains only the two owned source files.
